name: Mountain Herb Picking
description: I want to pick some of this village's famous Mountain Herbs for my brother in town, but there are too many monsters! Could you please go out for me and bring back 5 Mountain Herbs?

name: An Anteka in the Snow
description: In the Eastern lands, it is said that an Anteka's antlers are good for one's health. I would like to test this proverb. Please acquire 3 of these antlers for this purpose.

name: Hunt the Carnivore!
description: HELP! The children are being attacked by small, white monsters called Giaprey! 5 of the beasts are outside! Do something! Please! Think of the children!

name: Sinking Feeling
description: As usual, I went into the mountains on my hunt for Popos; however, today they were frightened and fled to the summit. Something must be up there... Please get the Popo Tongues for me!

name: Slay the Blangos!
description: Whew! That was incredibly scary! On my walk up the mountain road, some Blangos began to chase me! I think they are still up there, so please slay them quickly!

name: The Carnivorous Leader
description: It seems that I can trust you with a difficult job like this. I'd like you to hunt down the leader of a Giaprey pack, the Giadrome. I wish you a beautiful victory in our defense!

name: Gathering - Snowy Mountains
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the snowy mountains. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up.

name: Gathering - Jungle Zone
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the jungle. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up.

name: Gathering - Desert Zone
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the desert. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up.

name: The Carnivorous Leader
description: It seems that I can trust you with a difficult job like this. I'd like you to hunt down the leader of a Giaprey pack, the Giadrome. I wish you a beautiful victory in our defense!

name: Reckless Bulldrome Hunter
description: My son decided to become a hunter and ran off after a Bulldrome on his own! Of course, now the tables have turned and I'm worried! Hunt down the Bulldrome on the snowy mountains!

name: Slay the Giaprey!
description: I chased off a Giaprey that was feeding on my Popos, but now it's back with 19 of its buddies! I can't take on the whole lot of them! Hunters, this is your chance! Please get rid of them for me!

name: The Pack of Blangos
description: I request that you slay the Blangos rampaging through the mountains... A Bulldrome was also spotted in the area. Successfully avoid the Bulldrome and go about your mission.

name: The Taboo of Negligence!
description: The Mountain Herb, one of the seven sacred mountain flowers, truly captures the spirit of the mountains. There shouldn't be any wyverns in this weather, so you may gather with ease.

name: Hunt Down the Velocidrome!
description: It seems that whenever my wife goes to pick mushrooms in the Jungle, a large carnivore appears! There's no way I can let her go pick mushrooms now... Please! Make the Jungle safe again!

name: Jungle Menace
description: I want you to hunt and kill the giant bird-like monster that has appeared in our jungle. It's wreaking havoc on our environment and must be stopped!

name: Rarest of the Rare Beasts
description: Do you know of a pink, fanged beast that roams the jungle? That beast has dirtied my shop beyond hope! It's impossible to clean up! Get rid of it before I'm soiled again!

name: Hunt the Rare Forest Congas!
description: I took a trip to the jungle and saw some beautiful pink animals with fangs. But when I tried to pet them from my carriage, the beasts made a stink on me! I can't get it off! Punish those meanies!

name: Attack of the Giant Bugs!
description: My village is under attack by a swarm of bug monsters! It seems there are about 20 of them. One on one they are not a threat, but as a group they are deadly. So be careful.

name: Collect to Combine
description: An affinity towards combining is important, but so are fresh raw materials! Special Mushrooms from the jungle are sure to improve your hunting life and wallet! Gather 10 of them!

name: Hunt the Gendrome!
description: My caravans are being hit by packs of Genprey. It appears there is an extraordinarily powerful boss among them! Hunt down the monster and make the roads safe again for all!

name: The Land Shark
description: Our pack-animals were eaten by something in the desert. But nobody actually saw the monster attack! Track down this vile beast and take it out!

name: Liver of Legend!
description: Hello sirs and madams! I deal in rare items that I find in the desert. Recently I've got a buyer for Piscine Wyvern and Sand Wyvern livers. Deliver 3 of them to me!

name: Gone Fishin'
description: Fishing. It carries on in the hearts of children and remains a simple pleasure for adults. Hearken back to a simpler time and bring me back 2 of the desert's most precious gift... Goldenfish!

name: Shadow in the Snow
description: If it's not one thing, it's another, right? Near the village, a strange flying wyvern called a Khezu has been spotted. It is strong, but I believe you can handle it. Do your very best!

name: Gathering - Swamp Zone
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the swamp. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up.

name: Gathering - Forest and Hills
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the forest and hills. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up.

name: Shadow in the Snow
description: If it's not one thing, it's another, right? Near the village, a strange flying wyvern called a Khezu has been spotted. It is strong, but I believe you can handle it. Do your very best!

name: The Subterranean Glutton
description: I'm after the rare larvae of the Khezu. They should be on the summit, so search there. These whelps aren't to be taken lightly. If you run out of Pickaxes, combine a bone with a rock!

name: Blango Slaying Tactics
description: The pelt of a Blango can be made into various pieces of armor that are useful in everyday life. Slay 10 of the beasts and bring me their pelts. Beware of the Giadrome.

name: Aim for the Jungle Crab
description: I've always longed to go hunting in the jungle! However, if a huge monster appeared, I'd be finished! Maybe you could take out the Daimyo Hermitaur for me?

name: Master of the Giant Lake
description: Hunt down the water wyvern that keeps harassing my shipyard! Your target is a monster covered in green scales that is more powerful than its cousin! Heh heh!

name: A Swarm of Hermitaurs
description: Fishing is no easy endeavor, but lately things have gotten out of hand! While unloading my ship, a swarm of Hermitaurs appeared. Slay 10 of them and let me get on with my work!

name: The Purple Poison Menace
description: I saw a gigantic bird-like monster deep in the jungle! It scared everyone so bad that I can't do business with a thing like that out there! Please hunt it down so I can work in peace!

name: The Lurking Desert Giant
description: When some of my clan went gathering in the desert, they were attacked by an enormous crab, nya! As long as he's around, we can't do business. Help us, nya!

name: Water Wyvern in the Desert
description: I found a giant water wyvern in a cave in the desert! I can't defeat it because it stays underwater. Slay it for me and the glory is all yours!

name: Slay the Genprey!
description: I'm too injured to go on... The Genprey living in the desert have the power to paralyze their foes. I'd like you to find the pack that did this to me and kill 20 of the fiends!

name: Gypceros: Venomous Terror
description: The fields all around the town are getting torn to shreds by a gigantic poisonous bird-like monster. Exterminate it for us! Its poison can melt crops, so be careful it doesn't melt you!

name: Attack of the Blue Kut-Ku
description: That big eared Yian Kut-Ku really made mincemeat out of me! It's out of my league, so I want you to hunt it down for me! He's all yours!

name: The Mischief-maker
description: I took a trip to the swamp and saw a pretty pink animal with fangs. But when I tried to call it to the carriage, it threw something dirty at me and now I can't get the smell off! Punish it!

name: Fang of the Iodrome!
description: My village is under attack by a pack of Ioprey. Inside their pack, they are led by an incredibly large boss with poison filled fangs. Slay this creature for us!

name: Slay the Great Kut-Ku!
description: A bird-like Yian Kut-Ku is attacking people the world over! It has even shown up in these very hills! If it isn't eliminated soon, we're finished! Show me what you're made of!

name: A Killing from Mushrooms
description: Prices on mushrooms from the forest and hills have skyrocketed. Please gather 10 of them for me and I'll cut you in on the profits! But beware of the Kut-Ku rumored to roam the area.

name: The Ruler of the Snow
description: My next request requires a true master... Care to test yourself? I'd like you to hunt down the chief of the snowy mountains. Remember, on this quest negligence is unforgivable.

name: Gathering - Volcanic Zone
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the Volcanic Belt. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up.

name: The Ruler of the Snow
description: My next request requires a true master... Care to test yourself? I'd like you to hunt down the chief of the snowy mountains. Remember, on this quest negligence is unforgivable.

name: Red Shadow in the Swampland
description: I've always longed to venture into the swamp! I think I could hunt down a Kelbi, but I could never fight a wyvern. Maybe you'd take care of this special monster for me...

name: The Lone Black Garuga
description: A Yian Garuga has been spotted in the jungle and there is now a vigorous search on for this atrocious beast. It has downed many a hunter, so take care as you hunt it!

name: Twin Velocidrome
description: 2 Velocidrome and their brood have long been menacing this area. Please destroy the two Velocidrome to disperse the pack and return peace and quiet to the jungle!

name: Attack of the Giant Bugs!
description: My plantation's under attack by giant bugs! They nest in the jungle, in a swarm of about 20. Take care of them for me!

name: Battle of the Blos
description: This is a request to the virtuous hunters of Pokke. A Monoblos is tearing through the desert near my village of Kokoto. Please hunt it down for us!

name: The Silver Horn
description: I beseech you for help! An old enemy has cut our hunters down to the last man... I fled to tell you that the silver horned White Monoblos terrorizes us once again! Rid us of it!

name: Supreme Ruler of the Swamp
description: Hunters! It is time to hunt down the Shogun Ceanataur. Let us rid the swamp zone of this menace and expand our strategic possibilities. This is a highly classified hunt. So don't tell a soul!

name: Trapped by Yian Kut-Ku
objective: Hunt the Yian Kut-Ku and Blue Yian Kut-Ku
description: The Yian Kut-Ku are circling, screaming in their shrill voices. Everyone is trapped inside the town! Please do something!

name: The Ioprey Leader
description: We were just in a fight with a pack of Ioprey, but were routed and had to retreat before we could defeat their leader. Hunt it down for us, but beware of its poison attacks.

name: Basarios: Unseen Peril
description: A wyvern attacked my team from out of the blue while we were on an expedition to the Volcanic Belt. Where did it come from? Please slay it!

name: Commander in the Flames
description: Upon our trip into the cave at the volcano, an enormous Shogun Ceanataur dropped down from the ceiling right on top of us! Its ambush caused massive damage! Rid the world of that scourge!

name: Ioprey Hunting
description: While mining for ore, we encountered a huge Ioprey nest deep inside our tunnel! We can't continue working unless you kill 20 of them for us!

name: A Band of Ceanataurs
description: I wanted to keep digging in search of the ultimate treasure trove... But some Ceanataurs smashed my Pickaxe! If you don't get rid of them, there will be no digging for me! Help me!

name: More Coal Please
description: We need Coal to power our ambush spear cannon. Go to the Volcanic Belt and mine the reserves there! If you're worried about Pickaxes, combine a long cylindrical bone and a rock.

name: The Frozen Dictator
description: I saw it! I saw it! In the middle of a blinding snow storm, there it was; dark black wings were dancing in the sky... No mere human could stand up to it! Don't even think of hunting it!

name: The Elder Dragon of Wind
description: There was surely a vortex inside of that downpour. The wind wrapped around and revealed Kushala Daora! I don't foresee anyone defeating it. Weaken it and then drive it away!

name: Hermitaur Buffet
description: I went to open up the little arena that hasn't been used in a while one morning, and I find that a band of Hermitaurs have turned it into their home! Now I need your help to turn them out!

name: Absolute Power
description: The Tigrex, said to be an ancestor of today's wyverns, has finally made an appearance. With such a powerful beast on the loose, the village is not safe. Hunt it down at once!

name: The Legendary Kirin
description: That must have been the phantom beast... The faint glow, and how it seemed to glide over land... There's no doubt that amazing riches await its slayer!

name: Two Roars in the Snow
description: It happened in an instant... Two Blangongas destroyed all the trees around my house. Now all I want to do is hunt them down so I can get my revenge. Please help me!

name: The Poison Siege
objective: Hunt the Gypceros and Purple Gypceros
description: Two poisonous fowl have appeared in the jungle. With them there, the jungle flowers will surely wilt and die! Go kill them... Now!

name: The Tigrex's Roar
description: I have an urgent request from a hunter on an expedition in the desert! It seems he has encountered the mighty Tigrex! Go to his aid and crush this beast at once!

name: The Runaway Diablos
description: A giant wyvern smashed the border-wall and ran into this area. We need to find and kill it before it causes any more trouble!

name: The Fierce Black Horn
description: I had hired the most skilled hunters imaginable, and went on a safari for the famed Diablos... But what we found was no mere Diablos! We must slay that black horned wyvern! No matter what!

name: Ultimate Crab Dinner
description: I am a true connoisseur of crab cuisine, and as such a connoisseur, I suspect the Daimyo Hermitaurs found in the desert are incredibly tasty! One is never enough, so hunt down two!

name: Black Rock in the Swamp
description: Even in the relative calm of the swamp zone, something has stirred up the monsters. In particular, heavily armored wyverns have been attacking us. Can you help us out?

name: Seeking the Strange Mask
description: This is awful! The princess saw some strange masked monsters that made her run for the hills! We're sending troops on a hunt for the fiends, so track down the masked marauders!

name: Terror of the Gravios
description: A fearsome Gravios has appeared amidst the magma and desolation of the Volcanic Belt. Hunt down the fire breather for us!

name: Check the Ancient Tower
description: A relic of olden days, the ancient tower is now off-limits. Those examining it should beware the danger posed by the Remobras. They must be defeated before entering the tower!

name: The Empress's Blazing Throne
description: We've received a communique from headquarters. An elder dragon has appeared in the Volcanic Belt. Fight the dragon and collect data on its behavior!

name: Overseer of the Ancients
description: Near the forbidden ancient tower, the Lunastra, empress of the elder dragons, is building a nest. Hunters! Who among you can defeat this ancient beast!? Exhibit your true skills!

name: The Elder Dragon of Mist
description: Our intuition told us to turn around, but we thought no one was there... Yet even though no one should've been there, we were attacked from behind! Beware! It was an enemy never before seen!

name: Towards the Silence
description: It seems an unknown elder dragon has appeared in the swamp zone. However, no one truly got a clear look at it. What could the beast have been? Slay it, but proceed with caution!

name: Small Shadow over the Swamp
description: I was gathering mushrooms in the Swamp when a Khezu appeared, but it was no ordinary Khezu. What was so different about it? You'll know as soon as you see it!

name: Congalala Territorial Fight
description: Two Congalalas have started a territorial fight over the Swamp. If they're not stopped soon, it'll ruin commerce in the area! Please hurry and put an end to their dispute!

name: A Troublesome Pair
description: A pair of fire wyverns have taken up residence in the hillside. If you are able to hunt them by yourself, you are truly a top class hunter. Care to try your luck?

name: A Troublesome Pair
description: A pair of fire wyverns have taken up residence in the hillside. If you are able to hunt them by yourself, you are truly a top class hunter. Care to try your luck?

name: Dual Plesioth
objective: Hunt the Plesioth and Green Plesioth
description: The water wyvern known as Plesioth is raging in the jungle. And not just one of them! Head off immediately to slay them!

name: Pink Dance in the Jungle
description: I've always longed to be a hunter, but a meeting with a Rathian ended that! Now that I know what it takes, I'll start over, but you have the spirit to hunt down that Rathian!

name: Four Horns
objective: Hunt the Diablos and Black Diablos
description: I simply can't bear to think about the terror and pain those Diablos are causing my people. I can't sleep at night with that worry! Hunt down those 2 Diablos for me!

name: Emperor of Flame
description: I have an earnest request of you... I want you to fight the elder fire dragon we cornered in the Volcanic Belt! Weaken it with your repeated counterattacks and then finally slay the beast!

name: A Sun with Fangs
description: While in the secluded desert village, I spotted an elder dragon with red scales! While I do know some hunters, it would be wrong to make this request of them... So it's up to you!

name: The Shogun's Encampment
description: Hey! Hey! Have you heard the news!? There's a rumor that two enormous monsters with thick shells have appeared in the Volcanic Belt! There must be a hunter somewhere who can face them!

name: Attack of the Rathalos
description: It cannot be... We tried so hard to kill it... But... My entire war band was wiped out by a wyvern. Now it all rests upon your shoulders, monster hunter! Slay it!

name: A State of Crisis!
objective: Defend the Town from Shen Gaoren
description: Gather, bold hunters! You are the lynchpin of our national defense! A menace creeps towards this town. You must repel this monster and defend the fort.

name: The Final Invitation
description: There are two Rajang, each with golden fur. Hunters, I have prepared a special stage for your grandest performance. Demonstrate your true power... He he he...

name: A Giant Dragon Invades!
description: A giant dragon has attacked our fort! If the fort falls, so too do our lands! Use its installed weaponry to make this beast pay for its indiscretions!

name: A True Foe - The Giadrome!
description: Within a group of the sly carnivorous Giaprey, there is a leader. They call it the Giadrome. I need a hunter's strength to show that pack of beasts and their leader who's boss!

name: Reckless Bulldrome Hunter
description: My son decided to become a hunter and ran off after a Bulldrome on his own! Of course, now the tables have turned and I'm worried! Hunt down the Bulldrome on the snowy mountains!

name: A Pack of Blangos
description: A large pack of Blangos are massing nearby. They are violent enough that a large group will quickly become uncontrollable. Please slay 15 of the apes!

name: Mountain Herb Picking
description: I want to pick some of this village's famous Mountain Herbs for my brother in town, but there are too many monsters! Could you please go out for me and bring back 20 Mountain Herbs?

name: Rarest of the Rare Beasts
description: Do you know of a pink, fanged beast that roams the jungle? That beast has dirtied my shop beyond hope! It's impossible to clean up! Get rid of it before I'm soiled again!

name: Hunt the Rare Forest Congas!
description: I took a trip to the jungle and saw some beautiful pink animals with fangs. But when I tried to pet them from my carriage, the beasts made a stink on me! I can't get it off! Punish those meanies!

name: A Mushroom Goldrush!
description: Mushrooms from the jungle are skyrocketing in price! If you were to gather 20 of them for me, you would be justly compensated. However, I hear the area is infested with carnivores, so beware!

name: The Land Shark
description: A villager was tracking a pack of monsters, but lost sight of them in the desert. Please find the leader of the pack and hunt it down for us.

name: The Giant Enemy Crab
description: A giant crab is wandering around the desert! However, no normal sword is capable of cracking its shell! I hate to ask for help from other hunters, but please lend me your skills!

name: The Lady Gourmet
description: I travel the world for new tastes and flavors. Now I want to try the liver of a Piscine Wyvern, a taste few others have experienced. Please bring me 8 of these livers!

name: The Shadow in the Mountains
description: We were exploring a snow-covered mountain near here, but stumbled on this disgusting blob-like monster! If you can't get rid of that thing, our research is doomed! Help us!

name: The King of the Mountains
description: A Blangonga has staked its claim to a piece of the snowy mountains. Now we can't enter the area to gather firewood. Exterminate the Blangonga!

name: A Swarm of Hermitaurs
description: Fishing is no easy endeavor, but lately things have gotten out of hand! While unloading my ship, a swarm of Hermitaurs appeared. Slay 10 of them and let me get on with my work!

name: Water Wyvern in the Desert
description: I found a giant water wyvern in a cave in the desert! I can't defeat it because it stays underwater. Slay it for me and the glory is all yours!

description: A bird-like Yian Kut-Ku is attacking people the world over! It has even shown up in these very hills! If it isn't eliminated soon, we're finished! Show me what you're made of!

name: Eliminate the Rathalos!
description: I request the assistance of only the bravest of hunters to find and hunt the Rathalos that has appeared near here. Of course, a handsome reward will be paid upon success.

name: Attack of the Rathian
description: My caravan was wiped out by the queen of the skies, the killer Rathian! I'll pay you whatever you ask if you hunt down that foul creature! Help me kind hunter, you're my only hope!

name: Gathering - Snowy Mountains
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A daytime gathering quest on the snowy mountains. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up.

name: Gathering - Jungle Zone
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A daytime gathering quest in the jungle. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up.

name: Gathering - Desert Zone

description: A daytime gathering quest in the desert. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up.

name: Giadrome Assault
description: After you killed those Giaprey, their leader showed up and it's not a happy camper! It's bigger, and has a green crest. Find it and kill it!

name: The Mountain Roughrider
description: The thick skinned Bulldrome is well adapted to life in the mountains. Yet it's nothing but a pest for those of us living amongst the peaks! Which is why I'd like you to get rid of it!

name: Slay the Giaprey!
description: I chased off a Giaprey that was feeding on my Popos, but now it's back with 19 of its buddies! I can't take on the whole lot of them! Hunters, this is your chance! Please get rid of them for me!

name: Find the Mountain Herbs!
description: Steeping Mountain Herbs in this special brew has miraculous medical effects. However, I've run out of the herbs essential to the concoction. Find 20 of them and bring them to me!

name: Hunt Down the Velocidrome!
description: It seems that whenever my wife goes to pick mushrooms in the Jungle, a large carnivore appears! There's no way I can let her go pick mushrooms now... Please! Make the Jungle safe again!

name: Blue Menace of the Jungle
description: I want you to hunt and kill the giant bird-like monster that has appeared in our jungle. It's wreaking havoc on our environment!

name: Cunning Raiders
description: A group of blue scaled, pack hunting carnivores called Velociprey have infested the jungle. Please slay 20 of them for us... But beware of their boss!

name: Attack of the Giant Bugs!
description: My village is under attack by a swarm of bug monsters! It seems there are about 50 of them. One on one they are not a threat, but as a group they are deadly. So be careful.

name: The Mushroom Hunt!
description: My doggie just looooves Special Mushrooms! I'd like you to bring me 20 of them, as I can't resist his puppy dog eyes. However, beware of that filthy pink vagrant brute!

name: Panning for Goldenfish
description: I'd do anything to get my hands on some legendary Goldenfish! I'm begging you to bring me 2 of them! Wait! Make that 3! Please catch these fish and bring them here!

name: Charge... Charge... Charge!
description: We have a plan to rid the swamp of the scourge of the Bulldrome; however, we do not have enough hunters for the job. That is why we need your help! Let us rid the swamp of this foul beast!

description: As the representative of the Hunter's Guild, allow me to lay out our request. We would like you to hunt down the proud ruler of the mountains, the Blangonga... But you must be prepared!
