description: Hunt down the water wyvern that keeps harassing my shipyard! Your target is a monster that can shoot water with incredible force, so beware! Heh heh heh!

name: The Pink Fur Party
description: A huge group of Congas, along with one of their big pink bosses are gathering together. Please get rid of 20 of them... I think it will drive the rest away! Help me, pretty please!

name: The Hidden Jungle Clouds
description: I thought dark clouds had covered the moon, but it was actually a swarm of Hornetaurs! The jungle is covered with the bugs and I need you to exterminate 50 of the Hornetaur pests!

name: The Underwater Terror
description: The lake underneath the desert is connected to an underground river and patrolled by a green-scaled water wyvern... If you are truly a hunter, then it should pose no problem.

name: Evening Hermitaur Sonata
description: Those pesky Hermitaurs are starting to get in the way of business. They hide in the sand and ambush you at a moment's notice. I also spotted a Daimyo Hermitaur, so be extremely careful!

name: The Purple Poison Menace
description: I saw a gigantic bird-like monster deep in the swamp! It scared everyone so bad that I can't do business with a thing like that out there! Please hunt it down so I can work in peace!

name: Pincer through the Sky
description: A Shogun Ceanataur is running rampant over the swamp zone! Whether it be human or animal, it is attacking everything in sight. Head to the swamp and end its reign of terror!

name: Chase the Poison Gypceros!
description: The Gypceros is known to have a fondness for shiny objects. It is also known to occasionally steal ore from humans. Slaying a Gypceros may net you some great treasures.

name: Trouble in the Forest
description: I'm a lumberjack and I'm not OK. Those boar-monsters, the Bullfangos, have been a lot of trouble lately. Can you thin the herd by 20? Much obliged.

name: Seeking the Strange Mask
description: This is awful! The princess saw some strange masked monsters that made her run for the hills! We're sending troops on a hunt for the fiends, so track down the masked marauders!

name: The Ioprey Leader
description: We were just in a fight with a pack of Ioprey, but were routed and had to retreat before we could defeat their leader. Hunt it down for us, but beware of its poison attacks.

name: Commander in the Flames
description: Upon our trip into the cave at the volcano, an enormous Shogun Ceanataur dropped down from the ceiling right on top of us! Its ambush caused massive damage! Rid the world of that scourge!

name: Basarios: Unseen Peril
description: A wyvern attacked my team from out of the blue while we were on an expedition to the Volcanic Belt. Where did it come from? Please slay it!

name: A Band of Ceanataurs
description: I wanted to keep digging in search of the ultimate treasure trove... But some Ceanataurs smashed my Pickaxe! If you don't get rid of them, there will be no digging for me! Help me!

name: Great Ore Discovery
description: In a corner of the volcanic belt, I discovered a great vein of coal in the rocks. I'd like you to mine the coal, but beware the Shogun Ceanataur! Take care and get mining!

name: A Giant Dragon Invades!
objective: Defend the Fortress from Lao-Shan Lung
description: A giant dragon has attacked our fort! If the fort falls, so too do our lands! Use its installed weaponry to make this beast pay for its indiscretions!

name: The Meeting of Daimyo
description: Help! There has been an explosion of so many Daimyo Hermitaurs near our fishing grounds that we can't handle things by ourselves! Get rid of as many as you can so we can get back to fishing!

name: Go Fish Goldenfish!
description: I've come from across the sands to sell all manners of strange and unusual wares, but I have a request. Please deliver to me 8 Goldenfish from the desert. I promise to reward you well!

name: Absolute Power
description: At last, the Tigrex has appeared! It is said the beast's origins are as a flying wyvern. It is too powerful to be allowed to run free. The village is in danger! Hunt it quickly!

name: Absolute Power
description: At last, the Tigrex has appeared! It is said the beast's origins are as a flying wyvern. It is too powerful to be allowed to run free. The village is in danger! Hunt it quickly!

name: The Tigrex's Roar
description: I have an urgent request from a hunter on an expedition in the desert! It seems he has encountered the mighty Tigrex! Go to his aid and crush this beast at once!

name: The Runaway Diablos
description: A giant wyvern smashed the border-wall and ran into this area. We need to find and kill it before it causes any more trouble!

name: The Fierce Black Horn
description: I had hired the most skilled hunters imaginable, and went on a safari for the famed Diablos... But what we found was no mere Diablos! We must slay that black horned wyvern! No matter what!

name: Valor in the Swamp Zone
description: Even in the relative calm of the swamp zone, something has stirred up the monsters. In particular, heavily armored wyverns have been attacking us. Can you help us out?

name: Terror of the Gravios
description: A fearsome Gravios has appeared amidst the magma and desolation of the Volcanic Belt. Hunt down the fire breather for us!

name: The King's Domain
description: Did you hear it!? That voice that shook the ground? It even scared the fearless mercenaries! It must have been the king of the skies! But if you're a real hunter, it won't be a problem!

name: Attack of the Rathalos
description: It cannot be... We tried so hard to kill it... But... My entire war band was wiped out by a wyvern. Now it all rests upon your shoulders, monster hunter! Slay it!

name: The Queen's Descent
description: A Rathian is making its nest in the jungle. This protective mother has made even stepping into the jungle a death sentence. Please clear the jungle of her threat.

name: The Cherry Blossom Rathian
description: A remarkably fierce Pink Rathian has rampaged through lands held by other monsters and caused a great upheaval. You must hunt down and eliminate her to restore order!

name: The Legendary Kirin
description: That must have been the phantom beast... The faint glow, and how it seemed to glide over land... There's no doubt that amazing riches await its slayer!

name: The Red and Green Wyverns
description: I must gather Herbs from the hillside if I am to cure my mother's illness. However, a fire breathing wyvern has settled into the area... If I do nothing, mama will only get worse. Please! Help me!

name: Attack of the Wind Dragon
description: A brown metal dragon is rapidly closing on the town. Scouts report that outlying areas have already been razed. If we don't stop this dragon, our town will be annihilated! We need you!

name: A Sun with Fangs
description: While in the secluded desert village, I spotted an elder dragon with red scales! While I do know some hunters, it would be wrong to make this request of them... So it's up to you!

name: Emperor of Flame
description: I have an earnest request of you... As the last of my responsibilities, I request your help. I want you to fight the elder fire dragon we cornered in the Volcanic Belt, but beware its flames!

name: Towards the Silence
description: It seems an unknown elder dragon has appeared in the swamp zone. However, no one truly got a clear look at it. What could the beast have been? Slay it, but proceed with caution!

name: Two Little Shadows
description: I was exploring the caverns with my assistants when two small, white shadows popped out of nowhere. Please do something about them as they are hindering my research! ...Actually, what are they??

name: A Horde of Congalalas
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: Large Congalalas continue to gather, and at this rate, they'll completely trash the Swamp and affect our town's way of life. I'm not asking that you get rid of them all, but even 2 would help!

name: The Approaching Gaoren
objective: Defend the Fortress from Shen Gaoren
description: Hmm... This is quite serious. The fort which lies at the heart of our defenses is under siege by a giant monster. We need your strength to hold our position!

name: Gathering - Snowy Mountains
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A nighttime gathering quest in the snowy mountains. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Be careful! Large monsters lurk nearby!

name: Gathering - Jungle Zone
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A nighttime gathering quest in the jungle. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Be careful! Large monsters lurk nearby!

name: Gathering - Desert Zone
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A nighttime gathering quest in the desert. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Be careful! Large monsters lurk nearby!

name: A True Foe - The Giadrome!
description: Within a group of the sly carnivorous Giaprey, there is a leader. They call it the Giadrome. I need a hunter's strength to show that pack of beasts and their leader who's boss!

name: Reckless Bulldrome Hunter
description: My son decided to become a hunter and ran off after a Bulldrome on his own! Of course, now the tables have turned and I'm worried! Hunt down the Bulldrome on the snowy mountains!

name: Flanked by Velocidrome
description: All the children in the village have gathered their allowances to pay you to get rid of two carnivores. Our parents couldn't do it, so it's up to you to defend our fields and animals!

name: Aim for the Jungle Crab
description: I've always longed to go hunting in the jungle! However, if a huge monster appeared, I'd be finished! Maybe you could take out the Daimyo Hermitaur for me?

name: The Poison Fanged Duo
description: There appears to be two Gendrome among the pack of Genprey ravaging the desert. This has caused the Genprey to become frenzied and attack humans. You must get rid of the leaders!

name: Pursuit of the Sand Wyvern
description: A giant sand wyvern has appeared in the desert along with a pack of Genprey. Forget about the Genprey, but take care of the Cephadrome so the merchants can return to work!

name: Ultimate Crab Dinner
description: I am a true connoisseur of crab cuisine, and as such a connoisseur, I suspect the Daimyo Hermitaurs found in the desert are incredibly tasty! One is never enough, so hunt down two!

name: Trapped by Yian Kut-Ku
objective: Hunt the Yian Kut-Ku and Blue Yian Kut-Ku
description: The Yian Kut-Ku are circling, screaming in their shrill voices. Everyone is trapped inside the town! Please do something!

name: Conga Counterattack!
description: I asked some hunters to slay a Congalala for me; however, they met defeat at the hooves of a Bulldrome. I didn't think it would come to this, but I need your help!

name: The Beating of Royal Wings
description: It's no use. No matter where I look, I can't seem to find the Vespoid Queen! Perhaps if you slayed a large number of Vespoids to make her feel that her swarm was in grave danger, she might appear...

name: Lao-Shan Lung Draws Near!
objective: Defend the Fortress from Lao-Shan Lung
description: It seems that once again our land is in crisis. The giant elder dragon Lao-Shan Lung is approaching the village from the mountains. Head to the fort and defend our way of life!

name: Gathering - Swamp Zone
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A nighttime gathering quest in the swamp. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Be careful! Large monsters lurk nearby!

name: Gathering - Forest and Hills
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A daytime gathering quest in the forest and hills. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Be careful! Large monsters lurk nearby!

name: Gathering - Volcanic Zone
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A nighttime gathering quest in the volcanic zone. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Be careful! Large monsters lurk nearby!

name: Two Roars in the Snow
description: It happened in an instant... Two Blangongas destroyed all the trees around my house. Now all I want to do is hunt them down so I can get my revenge. Please help me!

name: The King of the Mountains
description: A Blangonga has staked its claim to a piece of the snowy mountains. Now we can't enter the area to gather firewood. Exterminate the Blangonga!

name: The Electrified Wyvern
description: I wanted to test myself, so I went off in search of spotting a Bulldrome in the snowy mountains. But all of a sudden, a weird wyvern appeared and it shocked me! I'm still smoking!

name: Red Shadow in the Swampland
description: I've always longed to venture into the swamp! I think I could hunt down a Kelbi, but I could never fight a wyvern. Maybe you'd take care of this special monster for me...

name: The Poison Gas
objective: Hunt the Gypceros and Purple Gypceros
description: *cough* While I was practicing in the jungle, I was attacked by two poison wyverns! You can see their thick poison gas before your very eyes... They are tough, please defeat them! *cough*

name: Dual Plesioth
objective: Hunt the Plesioth and Green Plesioth
description: The water wyvern known as Plesioth is raging in the jungle. And not just one of them! Head off immediately to slay them!

name: Attack of the Rathian
description: My caravan was wiped out by the queen of the skies, the killer Rathian! I'll pay you whatever you ask if you hunt down that foul creature! Help me kind hunter, you're my only hope!

name: Water Wyvern in the Desert
description: I found a giant water wyvern in a cave in the desert! I can't defeat it because it stays underwater. Slay it for me and the glory is all yours!

name: The Underwater Terror
description: The lake underneath the desert is connected to an underground river and patrolled by a green-scaled water wyvern... If you are truly a hunter, then it should pose no problem.

name: An Evening Soaked in Poison
description: The swamp's poison is mixing with the Iodrome's poison... It is a terrible scene! We need a professional hunter to assist us... Show us your skills!

name: Supreme Ruler of the Swamp
description: Hunters! It is time to hunt down the Shogun Ceanataur. Let us rid the swamp zone of this menace and expand our strategic possibilities. This is a highly classified hunt. So don't tell a soul!

name: The Purple Poison Menace
description: I saw a gigantic bird-like monster deep in the swamp! It scared everyone so bad that I can't do business with a thing like that out there! Please hunt it down so I can work in peace!

name: Eliminate the Rathalos!
description: I request the assistance of only the bravest of hunters to find and hunt the Rathalos that has appeared near here. Of course, a handsome reward will be paid upon success.

name: The Shogun's Encampment
description: Hey! Hey! Have you heard the news!? There's a rumor that two enormous monsters with thick shells have appeared in the Volcanic Belt! There must be a hunter somewhere who can face them!

name: Basarios: Unseen Peril
description: A wyvern attacked my team from out of the blue while we were on an expedition to the Volcanic Belt. Where did it come from? Please slay it!

name: Envoy to Disaster
description: The volcano has erupted with a deluge of black snake-like wyverns. They are the envoys to disaster. Hunt 20 of these Remobras down and appease the mountain gods.

name: Lao-Shan Lung Draws Near!
objective: Defend the Fortress from Lao-Shan Lung
description: It seems that once again our land is in crisis. The giant elder dragon Lao-Shan Lung is approaching the village from the mountains. Head to the fort and defend our way of life!

name: Meeting of the Blangongas
description: It-it-it's awful! A group of Blangongas are gathering on the mountain! With all those brutes in one spot, it means trouble for the village! Please help us!

name: The White Brute
description: We came to this land seeking the fabled Kirin, and at last we had found it! But the heavens opened and lightning struck, scattering our team. We need your help to save our co-workers!

name: Pricy Mushrooms, Shaka!
description: Have you ever heard of "Select Mushrooms"? Collect just 3 of them and you'll be rich beyond belief! Although I have heard that the King Shakalaka keeps a tight watch over those things...

name: Twin Walls of the Jungle
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: Oh, the atmosphere is abuzz, and the land tells me of the monsters' fury! Great Hunter, I call upon you to put a stop to the Blue Yian Kut-Ku and the Rathian that appears after it falls!

name: The Meeting of Sea and Air
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: Oh me, oh my! A Daimyo Hermitaur and a Green Plesioth have both appeared in the same area. I'm in search of a hunter who'll rid me of them one by one. Won't anyone step forward?

name: Red Lightning, Violet Blade
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: A Khezu and a Shogun Ceanataur have descended upon the swampland and are really going at it! If we don't put an end to them quick, we may end up with a lot of casualties! Heeeeelp!

name: Land of the Tremors
description: A group of highly skilled hunters went off to slay two Tigrex, but they became the hunted. Please destroy the two Tigrex and open a clear route for our rescue team.

name: Land of the Tremors
description: A group of highly skilled hunters went off to slay two Tigrex, but they became the hunted. Please destroy the two Tigrex and open a clear route for our rescue team.

name: The Rajang in the Snow
description: I had never seen the fanged beast with two horns on its head before, and I never want to again with the way it was rampaging across the snow!

name: The Tigrex's Roar
description: I have an urgent request from a hunter on an expedition in the desert! It seems he has encountered the mighty Tigrex! Go to his aid and crush this beast at once!

name: Pink Dance in the Jungle
description: I've always longed to be a hunter, but a meeting with a Rathian ended that! Now that I know what it takes, I'll start over, but you have the spirit to hunt down that Rathian!

name: The Runaway Diablos
description: A giant wyvern smashed the border-wall and ran into this area. We need to find and kill it before it causes any more trouble!

name: Four Horns
objective: Hunt the Diablos and Black Diablos
description: I simply can't bear to think about the terror and pain those Diablos are causing my people. I can't sleep at night with that worry! Hunt down those 2 Diablos for me!

name: Rajang of Mountain Flames
description: I went up to the snowy mountains to view the aurora, but the truth is that I hate the cold! That's when it hit me! I should have a coat made from Rajang fur! Hunt one for me!

name: Terror of the Gravios
description: A fearsome Gravios has appeared amidst the magma and desolation of the Volcanic Belt. Hunt down the fire breather for us!

name: Black Rock in the Swamp
description: Even in the relative calm of the swamp zone, something has stirred up the monsters. In particular, heavily armored wyverns have been attacking us. Can you help us out?

name: A Troublesome Pair
description: A Rathalos and Rathian have paired up and are ravaging my country! I wanted to end their reign of terror, but my father will not allow it! Please! Defeat them for me!

name: Blue Sky, Pink Earth
objective: Hunt the Azure Rathalos and the Pink Rathian
description: Did you see the two wyverns that appeared in the hills? An azure-shelled Rathalos and a pink-scaled Rathian... Hunting them down would surely make you a top hunter! ...Try your luck?

name: Attack of the Rathalos
description: It cannot be... We tried so hard to kill it... But... My entire war band was wiped out by a wyvern. Now it all rests upon your shoulders, monster hunter! Slay it!

name: Deny the Silver Rathalos
description: I have a request to all excellent hunters. I would like you to hunt down the silver wyvern that lives in the forgotten tower. OK... You don't even have to be excellent.

name: Find the Golden Phantom
description: All of my rations were gone and I was fading out of consciousness when out of the corner of my eye I saw ancient ruins and a golden wyvern up above. Was it all a dream? Find the truth!

name: The Fleeting Shadow
description: I saw them! I really did! The ground was bathed in sparks as two phantom beasts bathed in a lava pool! It was not a dream! You've gotta believe me! Go see for yourself!

name: The Elder Dragon of Wind
description: There was surely a vortex inside of that downpour. The wind wrapped around and revealed the elder dragon, Kushala Daora! There isn't a single soul who can combat it alone, so fight together!

name: The Frozen Dictator
description: I saw it! I saw it! In the middle of a blinding snow storm, there it was; dark black wings were dancing in the sky... No mere human could stand up to it! Don't even think of hunting it!

name: The Elder Dragon of Mist
description: Our intuition told us to turn around, but we thought no one was there... Yet even though no one should've been there, we were attacked from behind! Beware! It was an enemy never before seen!

name: Towards the Silence
description: It seems an unknown elder dragon has appeared in the swamp zone. However, no one truly got a clear look at it. What could the beast have been? Slay it, but proceed with caution!

name: The War of Immolation
description: This is truly an emergency! A red fire-breathing dragon is approaching this very town! This is no time to dilly-dally! We need the help of every skilled hunter in this land!

name: Emperor of Flame
description: I have an earnest request of you... As the last of my responsibilities, I request your help. I want you to fight the elder fire dragon we cornered in the Volcanic Belt, but beware its flames!

name: Legendary Black Dragon
description: The legendary black dragon... It really exists then? We've prepared all instruments of war to assist you in your quest to destroy the dragon. The fate of the nation lies in your hands.

name: The End Times
description: It appears the time has finally come. The bloodstained scales of the red dragon have graced the earth again in flaming glory. If you can stop this beast...

name: Ancestral Dragon
description: Hee hee hee... The time has come. Here is your invitation to the ball. Wear your Sunday best and bring your greatest weapon, for it is time to go to the dance with the king of disaster.

name: Wyvern of the Wind
description: The Nargacuga of the Great Forest... It's so fast, I could barely see it. But please, if there is one request that needs to be fulfilled, it's this one!

name: Born of Darkness
description: All of my friends... gone. I saw a tail swish through the air, and 2 red lights. That's all. That thing's not a monster; it's a demon! Someone exorcise it, please!

name: Two Queens
objective: Hunt the Rathian and the Pink Rathian
description: Think you can handle two Rathian at the same time!? Then come on down to the Arena, the only place to test your might! We eagerly await your arrival, Hunter!

name: One-Horned Demon King
description: Ah, I tried to slay it, but I was in way over my head. Still, I can't let it go, so I ask that if you have the courage to face this beast, to please step forward.

name: Phantasmic Battle
description: I've received an urgent communique from my colleague who went to investigate deep inside the volcano. Please hurry, but be careful. The monster is a bit... unique.

name: Furious Beauties
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: Wh-What's going on...? All of a sudden, a ton of monsters just showed up in the Snowy Mountains! Any hunter willing to lend a hand, please come help us on the hunt!

name: Fight for the Throne
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: Help! There are some dangerous monsters lurking in the Forest and Hills, making it impossible for me to enter the area. But if I don't gather what I need, my mother's illness will...

name: Hotter than Hell Itself
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: We've received word that a Basarios and a Gravios are going wild inside due to volcanic activity. This is a very dire situation, and we require the immediate dispatch of a hunter.

name: Desert Unifier
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: My sister and I are in an argument over which is the most beautiful: Daimyo shells, Cephadrome scales, or Diablos horns. Seeing is believing, so I demand you bring all three to me!

name: The Approaching Gaoren
objective: Defend the Town from Shen Gaoren
description: Our town is embroiled in an unprecedented conflict. A fortress-like shelled monster is threatening our safety. We need help immediately!

name: Rise to the Summit
description: The combined strength of the Hunter's Guild has successfully cornered an Akantor in the Volcanic Belt. Now all that is left is to slay the beast, a task for only the most valiant.

name: Hypno, Hypno!
description: The Hypnocatrice is hurting so many people, so I tried to sneak out to the Great Forest. Unfortunately, I was spotted by a guard. Please, I ask that someone deal with that menace in my stead!

name: G-Lvl Gathering - Grt Forest
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A daytime gathering quest in the Great Forest. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Just be aware of the G-Level monsters, OK?

name: G-Lvl Gathering - Old Jungle
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the Old Jungle. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Just be aware of the G-Level monsters, OK?

name: G-Lvl Gathering - Old Desert
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the Old Desert. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Just be aware of the G-Level monsters, OK?

name: G-Lvl Gathering - Old Swamp
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the Old Swamp. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Just be aware of the G-Level monsters, OK?

name: G-Lvl Gathering - Snowy Mts.
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the Snowy Mountains. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Just be aware of the G-Level monsters, OK?

name: Shakalaka Showdown!
description: This time, I need a hunter to come with us as we go in search of treasure in the heart of the Great Forest. More specifically, I need you to be on the look-out for Shakalakas as we travel.

name: The Beating of Royal Wings
description: It's no use. No matter where I look, I can't seem to find the Vespoid Queen! Perhaps if you slayed a large number of Vespoids to make her feel that her swarm was in grave danger, she might appear...

name: The Big Dirt Nap
description: The Hypnocatrice, the sleep-inducing bird wyvern of the Great Forest. Those who face it usually end up taking a dirt nap, so its materials are highly coveted. So... You gonna give it a shot?

name: Hypno, Hypno!
description: The Hypnocatrice is hurting so many people, so I tried to sneak out to the Great Forest. Unfortunately, I was spotted by a guard. Please, I ask that someone deal with that menace in my stead!

name: Trapped by Yian Kut-Ku
objective: Hunt the Yian Kut-Ku and Blue Yian Kut-Ku
description: The Yian Kut-Ku are circling, screaming in their shrill voices. Everyone is trapped inside the town! Please do something!

name: Giant Crab of the Old Jungle
description: We came here to the Old Jungle in search of some materials when a giant crab chased us out of the area, nya! We can't make a living as long as that cretin is there. Please help us, nya!!

name: Daimyo of Sengoku Fame
description: I spotted an unusual variety of Daimyo Hermitaur out in the Old Desert. I don't know what it was, but I swear it was evil! Anyway, here's my proposition: Hunt the crab and make a fortune. Deal?

name: Wag the Dog!
objective: Hunt the Daimyo Hermitaur and the Plum D.Hermitaur
description: My grandfather stumbled on a fight between two famous warriors. They say that it's the dream of a warrior to die on the battlefield, but not by their own hands! Please go and help them!

name: Old Jungle Lightning
description: Just when I thought that maybe this time the peace would last, this happens! As long as that Khezu just sits there, we can't get out of the Old Jungle. Please, come to our rescue, hunter!

name: Red Shadow in the Snow
description: I've always longed to venture into the Snowy Mountains! I think I could hunt down an Anteka, but I could never fight a wyvern. Maybe you could take care of a special monster for me...

name: Tales from the Old Swamp
description: Ever since a long time ago, 2 gruesome wyverns have lived in the depths of the cave in the Old Swamp, their blood-red bodies surrounded in a sharp, blue glow... *gasp!* Look, behind you!

name: Eyes in the Underground Lake
description: The Plesioth of the Old Desert's underground lake... We've received an SOS from the group of secret hunters who were hunting this beast. Can you keep the Plesioth at bay while we rescue them?

name: Giant Green Waves of Verdure
description: Help! I've received word that a Green Plesioth has appeared along our Queen's route to another land. Please take care of it in secret for us before she enters the area!

name: Prodigal Pack Attack!
description: Congas have gathered in the Swamp and are destroying all the good mining points. Now, I'd hate for this to leak, but there's a great mining point in a secret place. Just keep that mum, OK?

name: Pelagus Pride
description: Hmph, how rude! Can you believe that awful beast spewed some nasty gunk at me three times in a row!? ...I beg your pardon? I still stink!? How dare you, you uncouth heathen!?

name: Trickster!
description: There is a child wandering lost deep in the Great Forest. Our rescue efforts have thus far failed due to a strange and rare, bearded beast... I ask that someone please hunt that thing down!

name: Stealing in the Jungle!
description: That Gypceros stole my very important Book of Combos, and then, right after that, a band of Melynx stole my BBQ Spit! At this rate, I'm going to be forced into early retirement! Heeeeelp!

name: Old Swamp, Shrouded in Mist
description: Gypceros are covered in a rubbery skin that's mostly waterproof, yet despite this, they like to live in areas of high humidity. Hmm... To solve this riddle, I'll require more data!

name: Subspecies Three!
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: Add a Blue Yian Kut-Ku to a Green Plesioth and you get a Plum D.Hermitaur. Seriously, uniquely-colored equipment is selling like hotcakes, especially with young folks. Wish I could get in on that.

name: Predators of the Swamp
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: Recently, the number of people disappearing in the swamplands has been on the rise and we think the reason is linked to monsters in the area. If you can, please help look into this for us.

name: Ever-Present Shadow
description: I saw a demon in the Great Forest so fast that I could barely even register its shadow as it flew by. My trusty partner is my sword, and I hate to beg, but I need some backup here!

name: G-Lvl Gathering - Frst&Hills
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A daytime gathering quest in the Great Forest. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Just be aware of the G-Level monsters, OK?

name: G-Lvl Gathering - OldVolcano
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A gathering quest in the Old Jungle. Gather all the materials you can from the field, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket to finish up. Just be aware of the G-Level monsters, OK?

name: Ever-Present Shadow
description: I saw a demon in the Great Forest so fast that I could barely even register its shadow as it flew by. My trusty partner is my sword, and I hate to beg, but I need some backup here!

name: Assassin of the Swamp
description: Our head drill sergeant was attacked while out on an expedition in the Old Swamp by an unknown assailant. We think it's probably a monster, but we require the assistance of a hunter!

name: Ancient Beauty, Black Beast
description: From within the midst of the Great Forest's mist, I saw two blood-red eyes! Rest assured I will pay you well, just please, someone come defeat this creature quick!

name: Lavasioth Sighting!
description: I'm in a fishing competition with my elder brother. We agreed to compare rubbings to determine the winner. Well, imagine how much I'd win by if I had a Lavasioth rubbing! I'm a genius!

name: River of Fire
description: From out of the rivers of lava came 2 Lavasioths! I am dead serious. And right in front of a good Powderstone deposit! Please, dear hunter! Hunt these two down so we may get back to work!

name: Strong Sword, Strong Shield
objective: Hunt the Daimyo Hermitaur and Shogun Ceanataur
description: The Arena! A place to show your skills to the world! For this event, we have released two crab-like enemies into the arena! All those ready to test their skills are welcome!

name: Commander in the Flames
description: Upon our trip into the cave at the volcano, an enormous Shogun Ceanataur dropped down from the ceiling right on top of us! Its ambush caused massive damage! Rid the world of that scourge!

name: Dark-Shelled Ceanataur
description: I was going to get some materials after my catnap from what I thought was an empty black shell, but it took off, nya! I'm so mad that I didn't get anything! You'd better help me, nya!

name: Under the Gaze of Heaven
objective: Hunt the Shogun Ceanataur and the Terra S.Ceanataur
description: My grandfather stumbled on a fight between two famous warriors. They say that it's the dream of a warrior to die on the battlefield, but not by their own hands! Please go and help them!

name: At Birds' Hill...
description: We were enjoying a lovely picnic in the forest, where even the small birds had come out of hiding to bathe in the sunlight. But then, a lick of flame came out of nowhere! What was that!?

name: A King, Robed in Smoke
description: Unbelievably, the king of all wyverns has appeared in the Old Volcano belt. To protect our temple, we went to fight it, but to no avail. Please, we humbly ask for your assistance, hunter!

name: The King's Domain
description: Do you hear that? A voice that makes the earth tremble. Soldiers who have never known defeat are knocked about by this sky king's roar, but that's what hunters are for, right?

name: Her Eternal Majesty
description: In order to hunt down the ferocious Rathian in our lands, we are asking for volunteers. Hunters! Show us your strength and hunt that which is called "Empress".

name: The Cherry Blossom Rathian
description: The terrible Pink Rathian. It invades other monsters' territory and throws them into disarray, and picks fights with them as well. We must quickly rid the world of such a dangerous monster!

name: Howling at the Moon
description: Heh, at long last I have laid eyes upon my prey, the Great Forest's Yian Garuga, though never in my wildest dreams did I think it would be so strong! Hunter, I call upon your assistance now.

name: The Yian Garuga Twins
description: Yian Garuga have appeared in the forest areas one by one. Unending cycles of inflamed violence has caused many casualties in the area. For the sake of the people, please do something quick!

name: The King of the Mountains
description: A Blangonga has staked its claim to a piece of the snowy mountains. Now we can't enter the area to gather firewood. Exterminate the Blangonga!

name: Copper Sands
description: My teacher believed that a subspecies of Blangonga lives in the arid sands of a desert, and went in search of it. People have forgotten about my teacher, but I want to know what happened!

name: Wild Monk of the Dunes
description: Oh my! I'm sure that was a Blangonga, but they only live in areas of extreme cold! What is one doing out here!? Ahh, I have no idea what's going on anymore, but please do something!

name: Basarios Season
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: I was hiding from a Basarios behind some boulders when it turned out to be another one! I thought I could hide behind some other boulders ahead of me, but it was yet another one! Somebody, help!

name: Operation Tropical Storm
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: We've received word that an airship made an emergency landing in the Jungle, but the area is home to a Daimyo Hermitaur, a Gypceros, and a Rathian. Hurry to the region and help hunt them down!

name: Save the Great Forest Town!
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: There's something strange in the air, and it's attracting all manner of monsters all at once! Right now, there's only 1 hunter for every 3 monsters so any help you can give would be fantastic!

name: Three Walls
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: The young master has gone on a most impossible hunt, I'm afraid; all for the hand of a certain beautiful lady knight. I fear it will not end well, so I ask that you please help him along!

name: A Hunter's Feast
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: I went to open up the arena that no one has used in a while. Lo and behold, it's now a den of monsters! They seem to like it there so much they were immediately up in arms. Please help me!

name: Lao-Shan Lung Draws Near!
objective: Defend the Fortress from Lao-Shan Lung
description: It seems that once again our land is in crisis. The giant elder dragon Lao-Shan Lung is approaching the village from the mountains. Head to the fort and defend our way of life!

name: The Floating Dragon
description: We have confirmed the Yama Tsukami's location at the old Tower! There is so much we have yet to understand about this floating dragon that we can't let this chance escape! Move out!

name: Absolute Power
description: At last, the Tigrex has appeared! It is said the beast's origins are as a flying wyvern. It is too powerful to be allowed to run free. The village is in danger! Hunt it quickly!

name: Land of the Tremors
description: A group of highly skilled hunters went off to slay two Tigrex, but they became the hunted. Please destroy the two Tigrex and open a clear route for our rescue team.

name: Sandstorm Summoner
description: I have heard that there is a hunter in this village of great skill. We have sent scores of soldiers, yet they are no match for the Diablos of the Old Desert. Please lend us your power, Hunter!

name: The Fierce Black Horn
description: I had hired the most skilled hunters imaginable, and went on a safari for the famed Diablos... But what we found was no mere Diablos! We must slay that black horned wyvern! No matter what!

name: Black Phalanges
description: SOS! Two gigantic black towers came rising out of the ground and threw us into disarray. The pressure of tens of thousands of troops on us; so this is a wyvern's might. Please help us out!

name: Armored Supremacy
description: Even us knights can't stand up to the Gravios's mighty heat ray. I know this is a big request, but can you please go and hunt this armored beast in our stead?

name: Terror of the Gravios
description: A fearsome Gravios has appeared amidst the magma and desolation of the Volcanic Belt. Hunt down the fire breather for us!

name: The Dark Cataphracts
description: Hunters who were escorting some scholars were attacked by a few Gravios. They managed to fend them off, but they are unable to leave the area. Please hurry to their rescue!

name: Explore the Unexplored
description: I'll tell you about a secret hunting ground, I will. It doesn't matter if it's day or night, the silver sun always shines, giving would- be hunters a good workout... Heh, heh, heh...!

name: A Single Beam of Moonlight
description: We were dazed and lost in a haze for days when we came upon a mysterious land. There, we spied a golden moon. If I tell you the location, will you look into the area for me in secret?

name: Descendants of the King
objective: Hunt the Silver Rathalos and the Gold Rathian
description: The silver-winged king and his gold-bodied queen. Whoever successfully hunts them both shall be known as the King of Hunters. I await your return with a glass held high!

name: Child of Destruction
description: The legendary Rajang has appeared at last, however, I will leave it for you other hunters as I have other matters to attend to. I have people back home waiting for my return, after all.

name: The Final Invitation
description: There are two Rajang, each with golden fur. Hunters, I have prepared a special stage for your grandest performance. Demonstrate your true power... He he he...

name: A Scenic Locale
description: They say there's a secret place where all manners of ancient monsters live together, and I have found it at long last... If you want, I will show this virgin land to you!

name: It's Electric
description: There's something causing lightning strikes in the heart of the Old Swamp. My theory is that this is proof that the mythical beast has come out of hiding. Isn't it absolutely fascinating?

name: Deathmatch on the Dunes!
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: The sprawling city in the oasis is under siege by a number of monsters. This is unprecedented! We must do what we can before something terrible befalls the city!

name: Fire, Electricity, Heat Ray
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: I'm checking out the disturbance in the Swamp. The large monsters are going crazy and there are a ton of casualties. Help fend them off so that we can find the source of the trouble.

name: The 3 Masters of the Volcano
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: I don't usually make requests, but today's an exception since I don't feel my best. ...What? H-How dare you!? I-I could do this job in my sleep! It's that easy! Ah, just come back safe...

name: Diamond Dust
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: Recently, the weather around the Snowy Mountains has been bad nonstop. Further, the monsters are hungry from a lack of food, and have started to violently attack each other. Please help us!

name: Hunter's Funeral
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: I went to open up the arena that no one has used in a while. Lo and behold, it's now a den of monsters! They seem to like it there so much they were immediately up in arms. Please help me!

name: Pride on the Line
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: If I don't pass this exercise, my father will force me to marry. But I've already sworn to myself that my only partner in life would be my trusty sword. Please, I need your help!

name: The Dragon of Steel
description: If you see a giant twister at night out on the dunes, you'd best run. That is no ordinary sandstorm, but a legendary Elder Dragon. But if you think you can defeat it, then please go ahead!

name: The Elder Dragon of Wind
description: There was surely a vortex inside of that downpour. The wind wrapped around and revealed the elder dragon, Kushala Daora! There isn't a single soul who can combat it alone, so fight together!

name: Emperor of Flame
description: I have an earnest request of you... As the last of my responsibilities, I request your help. I want you to fight the elder fire dragon we cornered in the Volcanic Belt, but beware its flames!

name: A Midnight Audience
description: The Teostra's hideaway can only be found during the darkest hour, but I have done it. Now, if you can keep a secret, I'll tell you where it is, and of course you will be well rewarded...

name: Evaporate into the Night
description: People think it's impossible to fight an enemy you cannot see, however, if one were to focus and "see" with their gut instinct... Well, if all else fails, just swing your weapon round and round!

name: Towards the Silence
description: It seems an unknown elder dragon has appeared in the swamp zone. However, no one truly got a clear look at it. What could the beast have been? Slay it, but proceed with caution!

name: The Floating Dragon
description: We have confirmed the Yama Tsukami's location at the old Tower! There is so much we have yet to understand about this floating dragon that we can't let this chance escape! Move out!

name: The Approaching Gaoren
objective: Defend the Town from Shen Gaoren
description: Our town is embroiled in an unprecedented conflict. A fortress-like shelled monster is threatening our safety. We need help immediately!

name: Legendary Black Dragon
description: The legendary black dragon... It really exists then? We've prepared all instruments of war to assist you in your quest to destroy the dragon. The fate of the nation lies in your hands.

name: The End Times
description: It appears the time has finally come. The bloodstained scales of the red dragon have graced the earth again in flaming glory. If you can stop this beast...

name: Ancestral Dragon
description: Hee hee hee... The time has come. Here is your invitation to the ball. Wear your Sunday best and bring your greatest weapon, for it is time to go to the dance with the king of disaster.

name: Absolute Zero
description: This village already owes you so much, but we need you now more than ever. I truly believe it has to be you. Please, go forth to the Snowy Mountain Peaks and fight the final fight!

name: Secret Request: Hypnocatrice
description: I told my mother that I wanted a hat adorned with a Hypnocatrice's tail feather, but she got mad and said I was being selfish. Therefore this is a secret request. You must tell no one, OK!?

name: Bullfangos in the Night
description: A Bulldrome and its pack are going hog-wild around a mining point for Ore. I don't want others to find that secret location, so please hunt them in secret for me.

name: Whack a Shakalaka
description: I went to open up the little arena that hasn't been used in a while one morning, and I find that it's been taken over by a group of strange, little... things! Now I need your help to take them out!

name: Carnivore Carnival
description: I went to open up the little arena that hasn't been used in a while one morning, and I find that it's been turned into a meat-lover's paradise! Please bring an end to their partying!

name: The Beating of Royal Wings
description: It's no use. No matter where I look, I can't seem to find the Vespoid Queen! Perhaps if you slayed a large number of Vespoids to make her feel that her swarm was in grave danger, she might appear...

name: Secret Request: Hypnocatrice
description: I told my mother that I wanted a hat adorned with a Hypnocatrice's tail feather, but she got mad and said I was being selfish. Therefore this is a secret request. You must tell no one, OK!?

name: The Burning Dunes
description: There is a gigantic Cephadrome here in the Old Desert. There are numerous casualties and a state of emergency has been declared. We're calling on all hunters everywhere to please help!

name: Stealing in the Old Swamp!
description: That Gypceros stole my very important Book of Combos, and then, right after that, a band of Melynx stole my BBQ Spit! At this rate, I'm going to be forced into early retirement! Heeeeelp!

name: The Purple Poison Menace
description: I saw a gigantic Gypceros lurking deep in the swamp! It scared everyone so bad that I can't do business with a thing like that out there! Please hunt it down so I can work in peace!

name: Target: Basarios
description: Off the record, I want you to hunt the Basarios down. You can tell the Guild that you failed and then sell the materials you get wholesale. Hmm? Oh no, this is a real request from the Guild...

name: Old Jungle Lightning
description: Just when I thought that maybe this time the peace would last, this happens! As long as that Khezu just sits there, we can't get out of the Old Jungle. Please, come to our rescue, hunter!

name: Red Shadow in the Snow
description: I've always longed to venture into the Snowy Mountains! I think I could hunt down an Anteka, but I could never fight a wyvern. Maybe you could take care of a special monster for me...

name: Congalalas' Assault
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: A large number of Congalalas are congregating in the Swamp and I want you to hunt them down. You must get rid of at least 2 of those horrid things for me. I won't accept any less!

name: The Meeting of Daimyo
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: Help! There has been an explosion of so many Daimyo Hermitaurs near our fishing grounds that we can't handle things by ourselves! Get rid of as many as you can so we can get back to fishing!

name: Epic Hunt in the Jungle!
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: So I hear a Yian Kut-Ku and a Daimyo Hermitaur are in the Jungle. Sounds like a job for me! Don't worry, if you fail I'll mop them up for you. You can count on it!

name: Secret Request: 2 Monoblos!
objective: Hunt the Monoblos and the White Monoblos
description: An ancient wall painting our country was researching was destroyed by a Monoblos, and as an art-lover, I won't stand for it! My father can't spare any soldiers, so you're my only hope!

name: The Remobra Den
description: I went to open up the big arena that hasn't been used in a while one morning, and I find that it's been turned into a Remobra nest! Please, I need you to help me clear them out!

name: The Sleepy Great Forest
description: I got a request to hunt some Hypnocatrices, but I have so many other things to do that I can't handle it all. Can you handle it in my stead, please? ...But please keep this a secret, OK?

name: Eyes in the Underground Lake
description: We've received a rescue request from a poacher out hunting the Plesioth of the underground lake in the Old Desert. We ask that you please hold the Plesioth off while we rescue the person.

name: Green Waves of Verdure
description: Help! I've received word that a Green Plesioth has appeared along our Queen's route to another land. Please take care of it in secret for us before she enters the area!

name: Elegy for a Lone Wolf
description: Phew... I barely made it out alive from that Yian Garuga. I'll tell you what. You keep it a secret and I'll let you know where you can find this sly, cool-headed beast. Have we got a deal?

name: Battle with the Monoblos
description: This is a request to the virtuous hunters of Pokke. A Monoblos is tearing through the desert near my village of Kokoto. Please hunt it down for us!

name: Secret Request: 2 Monoblos!
objective: Hunt the Monoblos and the White Monoblos
description: An ancient wall painting our country was researching was destroyed by a Monoblos, and as an art-lover, I won't stand for it! My father can't spare any soldiers, so you're my only hope!

name: Kut-Ku Calamity!
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: Aaaah!! A Kut-Ku here and a Kut-Ku there! The hillside is covered in a confusion of red and blue! We don't care if you have to get rid of them one at a time, but please, just do it!

name: Basarios Season
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: I was hiding from a Basarios behind some boulders when it turned out to be another one! I thought I could hide behind some other boulders ahead of me, but it was yet another one! Somebody, help!

name: A Shogun Tastes Like...?
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: I've had the pleasure of tasting some exotic foods in my social circles, and I'm afraid I've grown fond of Shogun meat. They're experiencing a population boom, so what better timing?

name: Bl-Bl-Blangongas!
objective: Survive until Time Over or Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
description: My request is this: Please hunt down a few Blangongas in a row! The beasts are too hard for the hunters of my village, so please keep this a secret and spare their pride. Good luck!

name: Operation Desert Winds
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: We've received word that an airship made an emergency landing in the Desert, but a Monoblos often walks through the area, and the desert lake is home to a Plesioth. Please hurry to the hunt!

name: Congalala in a Crab Shell
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: I spotted that Congalala I ran into last time fighting ferociously with Mr. Crab in the Swamp. I don't want anyone else to suffer as I have, so please do something about them both!

name: Sleepy Miasma, Poison Mist
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: The Jungle is naturally foggy, but this time, there was something unusual in the air. As it turned out, it's the fault of two monsters in particular. I wonder if you could hunt them down for us?

name: Carnivores of the Old Jungle
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: Recently, travelers through the Old Jungle have been disappearing... and we'd like for you to look into this. We believe this to be the work of monsters, but we would like confirmation.

name: Attack of the Wind Dragon
description: A brown Kushala Daora is rapidly closing on the town. Scouts report that outlying areas have already been razed. If we don't stop this dragon, our town will be annihilated! We need you!

name: Indigo Meteor
description: A perfectly clear desert night sky opened up and she descended down upon me... Her form was that of a breathtaking shooting star. Surely, I am to be her king. Come, she mustn't escape me!

name: The Empress's Blazing Throne
description: We've received a communique from headquarters. An elder dragon has appeared in the Volcanic Belt. Fight the dragon and collect data on its behavior!

name: Lao-Shan Lung Draws Near!
objective: Defend the Fortress from Lao-Shan Lung
description: It seems that once again our land is in crisis. The giant elder dragon Lao-Shan Lung is approaching the village from the mountains. Head to the fort and defend our way of life!

name: Secret Request: Nargacuga!
description: I couldn't sit by while the Nargacuga hurt our people, so I snuck out to go slay it... and failed. I can't face my father like this, so please defeat it for me in secret!

name: Secret Request: Nargacuga!
description: I couldn't sit by while the Nargacuga hurt our people, so I snuck out to go slay it... and failed. I can't face my father like this, so please defeat it for me in secret!

name: Assassin of the Jungle
description: Our head drill sergeant was attacked while out on an expedition in the Old Jungle by an unknown assailant. We think it's probably a monster, but we require the assistance of a hunter!

name: Land of the Tremors
description: We're the Mysterious Duo, able to silence even the crying of kids! Normally, the Tigrex is nothing to us, but our stomachs are acting up a bit today, so help us out...? Owahahaha! Hahaha!

name: A King, Robed in Smoke
description: Unbelievably, the king of all wyverns has appeared in the Old Volcano belt. To protect our temple, we went to fight it, but to no avail. Please, we humbly ask for your assistance, hunter!

name: Dancing Desert Queen
description: Wow, nothing like a hunting ground to get the blood pumping and the spirit ready for the hunt! Unfortunately, while I've been gone, the requests have been piling up. Can you lend me a hand!?

name: Descendants of the King
objective: Hunt the Azure Rathalos and the Pink Rathian
description: The azure sky-king and the pink, earthly queen. Whoever successfully hunts them both shall be known as the King of Hunters. I await your return with a glass held high!

name: Diablos, the Demon King
description: Ah, I tried to slay it, but I was in way over my head. Still, I can't let it go, so I ask that if you have the courage to face this beast, to please step forward.

name: The Four Spires
description: I saw four black towers rising up on the dunes... I know what I saw! It was no dream, but reality! Please, save the Old Desert Town and my two dear daughters from those menaces!

name: Armored Supremacy
description: Even us knights can't stand up to the Gravios's mighty heat ray. I know this is a big request, but can you please go and hunt this armored beast in our stead?

name: Two Black Suits of Armor
description: All of the hunters who have taken on this request have fallen one by one, until there was no one left who would even consider it. 'Tis lamentable, no? Is there no one who has the guts to try?

name: Explore the Unexplored
description: I'll tell you about a secret hunting ground, I will. It doesn't matter if it's day or night, the silver sun always shines, giving would- be hunters a good workout... Heh, heh, heh...!

name: A Single Beam of Moonlight
description: We were dazed and lost in a haze for days when we came upon a mysterious land. There, we spied a golden moon. If I tell you the location, will you look into the area for me in secret?

name: Fire Ring, Lunar Ring
objective: Hunt the Silver Rathalos and the Gold Rathian
description: A gold- and silver-colored wyvern have taken over the area our village was going to develop. We'd like to keep this area a secret, even from hunters we know, so we're counting on you!

name: Attack of the Rajang
description: Wahaha! It is I, the Mystery Man! I came here to drive the Instructor's Rajang crazy and to hinder the progress of his students! So, come on, take my job! It can be our secret. Wahaha!

name: It's Electric
description: There's something causing lightning strikes in the heart of the Old Jungle. My theory is that this is proof that the mythical beast has come out of hiding. Isn't it absolutely fascinating?

name: Diamond Dust
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: Recently, the weather around the Snowy Mountains has been bad nonstop. Further, the monsters are hungry from a lack of food, and have started to violently attack each other. Please help us!

name: Hard-Shelled Terrors
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: The princess has run off by herself to dig up some jewels in the Volcano! If someone were to find out, it would cause a huge stink. We haven't a moment to lose. Please set out at once!

name: Bird Wyvern All-Stars
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: I absolutely hate birds. I hate their voices, their beaks, their eyes -- every- thing! And just my luck, 3 bird-like monsters live right next to my house. ARGH! Please help me!

name: Sand Dune's Might
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: The scorching sands reveal a Monoblos while a Daimyo surfaces from underground and the roar of a Rathian echoes overhead. This isn't a request, but a warning. If you head out, return safely!

name: Evaporate into the Night
description: People think it's impossible to fight an enemy you cannot see, however, if one were to focus and "see" with your gut instinct... Well, if all else fails, just swing your weapon round and round!

name: The Elder Dragon of Mist
description: Our intuition told us to turn around, but we thought no one was there... Yet even though no one should've been there, we were attacked from behind! Beware! It was an enemy never before seen!

name: A Midnight Audience
description: The Teostra's hideaway can only be found during the darkest hour, but I have done it. Now, if you can keep a secret, I'll tell you where it is, and of course you will be well rewarded...

name: Fight for Your Life!
description: The Town is under attack from the Teostra! Casualties are high and it's only a matter of time before the town falls. We'll pay you whatever you ask; just hurry to their aid!

name: The Approaching Gaoren
objective: Defend the Fortress from Shen Gaoren
description: Hmm... This is quite serious. The fort which lies at the heart of our defenses is under siege by a giant monster. We need your strength to hold our position!

name: Monster Hunter
objective: Hunt all of the Large Monsters
description: I'm overjoyed at the chance to see a hunter as skilled as yourself. I sense that should you complete this final quest, you will come to know the true meaning of a hunter's life!

name: Rise to the Summit
description: We finally have the mighty Akantor cornered in the Volcano, but our forces are exhausted and there is mass confusion. Please, I humbly request that you secretly slay the beast for us!

name: Yian Kut-Ku Training
